d:
A massive, bipedal draconic species with thick, armored scales and a long, heavy tail ending in a jagged point. Small, glowing crimson eyes set into a wide, predatory maw with sharp fangs. Massive, leathery wings with tattered edges and four sharp claws on each hand. Dark charcoal-grey skin with pale purple underbelly plates.
BODY COLOR: charcoal-grey
